[[File:Lobster detail.png|left|150px]]
'''Lobster''' is a type of [[fish]] that restores 12 [[Hitpoints]] when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking [[raw lobster]] on a [[fire]] or [[cooking range]], requiring level 40 [[Cooking]] and granting 120 [[experience]] when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a [[burnt lobster]]. The [[burn rate]] decreases as the player's Cooking level increases, and it will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 74.

When eaten, the message {{Mes|You eat the lobster.}} is displayed.
